title: Travel Alerts for Countries with Zika Virus Infections
what_it_is: Travel Alerts for Countries with Zika Virus Infections

sections.label: Patient travel and MOH advisories
sections.summary: The patient travelled to Sao Paulo from late March to early May 2016, and MOH had issued advisories to travellers about mosquito bites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The patient had travelled to Sao Paulo, Brazil from late March to early May 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Before this, MOH had started issuing advisories to travellers to and from Zika-affected countries on how they could protect themselves against mosquito bites, which are the main mode of transmission.

sections.label: Pregnant women travel advice, agency cooperation
sections.summary: MOH advised pregnant women to postpone non-essential travel to Zika outbreak countries and works with MHA, ICA and CAAS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, MOH advised pregnant women to postpone non-essential travel to countries with ongoing Zika outbreaks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As part of our on-going efforts to prevent and manage infectious disease outbreaks, MOH works closely with other Government agencies, such as MHA, ICA and CAAS, as part of the Homefront Crisis Management System.

sections.label: Advisories for athletes and officials
sections.summary: MOH has been in touch with the Singapore National Olympic Council and Sport Singapore to provide advisories to athletes and officials.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: With regard to our athletes, we have been in touch with the Singapore National Olympic Council and Sport Singapore to provide advisories to our athletes and officials.

sections.label: Symptoms and 14-day monitoring
sections.summary: Symptoms mentioned are fever, rash, muscle ache, red eyes and headache, and this should be done in Brazil and 14 days after leaving.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I have mentioned earlier fever, rash, muscle ache, red eyes and headache.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: This should be done while they are in Brazil but also 14 days after they leave the country.

sections.label: Working with WHO and region
sections.summary: Because diseases spread globally, it is essential to work closely with WHO and regional counterparts to monitor and coordinate responses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Indeed, whether it is a Zika infection or any other outbreak, because of the global nature of the spread of such diseases, it is essential for us to work closely with WHO and also with our regional counterparts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Zika, for example, is already found in our neighbouring countries and we have to take steps to work together to monitor and also to coordinate our responses.
